mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread reporting King main thrust bearings as out of spec, with the thrust mains said to slip into the cap and block groove too easily and risk spinning for lack of interference fit. The snippet states King tech support confirmed the issue and advised against use.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully again: still no King or official reply, thread open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026.

mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread telling other builders to measure and inspect every King-brand bearing before installing. Framed as a general caution about King parts rather than one isolated set.

mentions.title: King Bearings Quality?
